text: What a beautiful thing, God, to give thanks, to sing an anthem to you, the High God!
sing your faithful presence all through the night,
I saw your work and I shouted for joy.
and all the evil men and women took over, You mowed them down, finished them off once and for all.
You, God, are High and Eternal.
Look at your enemies—ruined! Scattered to the winds, all those hirelings of evil!
you've honored me with a festive parade.
the rout of my malicious detractors. My ears are filled with the sounds of promise:
They'll grow tall in the presence of God,
lithe and green, virile still in old age."
My Mountain, my huge, holy Mountain!
